universal.title: Universal converter
universal.description: Convert images, audio, video and documents between formats, right on your device. Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, GIF and more (also from RAW and HEIC photos). Audio: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC, AAC. Video: MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, or extract only the audio. Documents: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, PDF, Markdown, HTML, EPUB and more.
universal.shortDescription: Convert images, audio, video and documents to any format
universal.longDescription: Everything happens in your browser: ImageMagick (WebAssembly) for images, WebCodecs for audio and video, LibreOffice, pandoc and PyMuPDF (WebAssembly) for documents. Files never leave your device. Document engines are downloaded only the first time they are needed.
